descriptionChirho: Hostile pursuit or systematic oppression directed against individuals or groups on account of their faith; the state or experience of being persecuted. Singular and plural forms are simple number inflections of the same meaning. Spanish 'persecucion/persecuciones,' Hindi 'satav/satavon,' Arabic 'idtihad/idtihadat,' Korean 'bakhae/bakhaedeul,' Swahili 'mateso.' Used in Synoptic and Pauline contexts for suffering endured by believers, including Jesus' teaching about persecution for righteousness (Mark 10:30) and Paul's catalogs of affliction (2 Cor 12:10; 2 Tim 3:11).
